candidates.title: Mumbai is already thirsty: Why the 2041 problem is really a 2026 problem
candidates.excerpt: Mumbai is experiencing a significant water crisis due to a supply deficit of over 500 million liters daily. The city's demand for water is expected to soar by 57% by 2041, surpassing current supply capabilities. Various infrastructure projects intended to enhance water supply are either delayed or in early planning stages. Desalination plants are in development, but they will only partially address the water shortage.
